card.title: The Man Who Sold His Dreams
card.premise: A tired man sells his dreams at the Midnight Shop to pay what he owes, until the shopkeeper asks for the oldest one.
card.human_emotion: The quiet grief of trading who you are for what you owe, and the relief of discovering it mattered to someone.
card.magical_element: A shop that buys dreams: selling them is what exhaustion feels like, trading away who you are one night at a time.
card.visual_anchor: Glass jars on endless shelves, each glowing with a tiny captured dream.
card.ending_image: A letter tucked beneath the old tree: Thank you. Keep this one.
card.lingering_question: What have I already sold to get through the month, and who was it really worth something to?

script.title: The Man Who Sold His Dreams
script.narration_direction: Intimate third-person storyteller at 2 AM: low, warm, unhurried, close to the mic. Let every pause breathe. No acting; the images do the work. A faint smile only on the final line.

lines.text: Fann sold his first dream at midnight.
lines.delivery: hushed, like a secret; let 'midnight' land softly

lines.text: The shop only appeared between twelve and twelve-oh-seven.
lines.delivery: matter-of-fact, as if everyone knows this

lines.text: No sign. Just a moon-shaped bell, and jars that glowed as if something inside was breathing.
lines.delivery: slower on 'breathing', a touch of wonder

lines.text: Fann was tired. Two jobs. Letters he was afraid to open.
lines.delivery: flat and weary; short stops between fragments

lines.text: The shopkeeper paid well for dreams.
So he slept without them, and woke a little richer, and a little less himself.
lines.delivery: gentle, sadder on 'a little less himself'

lines.text: Then she asked for the last one.
The oldest jar: a boy, a giant tree, a sea so blue it hurt.
lines.delivery: warmth creeping in; ache on 'it hurt'
the shopkeeper's line kindly, not villainous

lines.text: She tilted a mirror toward him.
Across the city, a girl who couldn't sleep was dreaming his dreams.
Fann carried the jar home. He left the money behind.
That night, he dreamed of the tree again.
Beneath it, someone had left a letter.
It said: Thank you. Keep this one.
lines.delivery: faint smile; the softest line of the episode

characters.name: Fann
characters.descriptor: Fann, a man in his early thirties, tall and slim, short thick black hair swept up and to the side with a loose strand falling over his forehead, light stubble along his jaw and chin with a faint moustache, warm dark-brown eyes under straight dark brows, light-brown skin, wearing a light-blue collared cotton shirt with the sleeves rolled to the forearm, dark grey trousers and a long mustard-yellow knitted scarf
characters.signature: long mustard-yellow knitted scarf; light-blue collared shirt

characters.name: Young Fann
characters.role: Fann as a child, inside the oldest dream
characters.descriptor: a 7-year-old boy with short messy black hair, light-brown skin and bright curious dark-brown eyes, wearing a white t-shirt, navy shorts and a mustard-yellow knitted scarf far too big for him

characters.name: The Shopkeeper
characters.descriptor: the Shopkeeper, an ageless woman who could be sixty or a hundred, long silver hair in a loose low braid, round gold wire spectacles, a calm half-smile, a deep plum knitted cardigan with small embroidered moon-phase buttons, a tiny brass moon-shaped bell pinned at her collar
characters.signature: plum cardigan, gold round spectacles, brass moon bell

characters.name: Mira
characters.role: the sleepless girl who receives Fann's dreams
characters.descriptor: a 9-year-old girl with a dark-brown bob and blunt bangs, fair skin with rosy cheeks, wearing oversized sage-green pajamas, hugging a worn orange stuffed fox
characters.signature: sage-green pajamas; worn orange stuffed fox

locations.name: The Midnight Shop
locations.descriptor: the Midnight Shop, a narrow and impossibly deep old shop with dark wooden shelves rising into shadow, hundreds of small glass jars each holding a softly glowing miniature scene, a worn wooden counter, a brass moon-shaped bell above the door, a round wall clock near 12:07
locations.lighting: amber glow from the jars, deep blue shadows between the shelves

locations.name: The city after rain
locations.descriptor: a quiet modern city at midnight after rain, narrow alleys and empty streets, wet asphalt reflecting warm windows, overhead cables, small shuttered shops, distant traffic lights
locations.lighting: warm window glow and wet reflections against midnight blue

locations.name: Fann's room
locations.descriptor: a small rented room with a narrow bed and grey blankets, a cluttered desk under the window with unopened envelopes and a cold cup of tea, a desk lamp, a rain-streaked window showing distant city lights
locations.lighting: one warm desk lamp against cold blue window light

locations.name: The Old Tree, in the dream
locations.descriptor: the Old Tree, a vast ancient tree with a gnarled mossy trunk and sprawling canopy growing from a grassy cliff above a turquoise sea, wildflowers in the grass, rocks along a pale sandy shore below
locations.lighting: bright midday sun, dappled shade under the canopy, towering sunlit cumulus clouds

locations.name: Mira's bedroom
locations.descriptor: a cozy, cluttered child's bedroom with a wooden bed, teal blanket and coral pillow, walls covered in drawings and framed pictures, string lights, a bedside lamp, plants in the corner
locations.lighting: warm lamp glow in rose and amber, soft darkness at the edges

shots.description: The impossible transaction, first frame: a dream changes hands across a counter.
shots.image_prompt: Extreme close-up on the worn wooden counter: Fann's hand sliding a small glass jar toward the Shopkeeper's waiting hand, inside the jar a tiny swirl of glowing light like a captured dream, the round wall clock blurred behind them with its hands at 12:07
shots.video_prompt: the light inside the jar swirls slowly like smoke, dust motes drift through the amber glow, the hands barely move
sfx: glass jar set down on wood

shots.description: The shop that should not fit between two buildings.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of a narrow rain-soaked alley, a tiny old shopfront glowing amber squeezed between two dark buildings where no gap should be, Fann small in the foreground seen from behind, looking up at it
shots.video_prompt: rain falls steadily, puddles ripple, the shop window's warm light flickers gently
sfx: distant car on a wet road

shots.description: Inside: endless shelves of glowing jars. The Shopkeeper, unhurried.
shots.image_prompt: Towering shelves of small glass jars, each glowing with a different tiny scene, the brass moon-shaped bell above the door still swaying, the Shopkeeper behind the counter polishing a jar with a half-smile
shots.video_prompt: jar lights pulse softly at different rhythms, the bell sways once and settles
sfx: low hum of the glowing jars

shots.description: Why he sells: exhaustion and unopened letters.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot, Fann sitting at his desk late at night with his forehead resting in one hand, a stack of unopened envelopes in front of him, a cold cup of tea, rain on the window behind
shots.video_prompt: rain trickles down the window, steam long gone from the tea, his shoulders rise and fall with one slow breath

shots.description: Dreamless sleep: the colour drains out of his world.
shots.image_prompt: High angle, Fann asleep in his narrow bed with a blank, still face, the whole room drained to cool greys and blues, the desk lamp switched off, only faint streetlight through the rain-streaked window
shots.video_prompt: faint streetlight shifts across the blanket, the room otherwise perfectly still

shots.description: The oldest jar, and the only face close-up: the moment he almost says yes.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up, Fann's face lit warm gold from below as the Shopkeeper holds up the oldest jar between them, inside it a tiny bright summer scene, Fann's eyes wide, wet and hesitant
shots.video_prompt: the jar's glow brightens slowly, reflections tremble in Fann's eyes
sfx: jar glow swelling into a soft hum

shots.description: Inside the jar: the brightest image in the episode, the day pole.
shots.image_prompt: A small boy in an oversized mustard scarf standing beneath the enormous old tree on the cliff, looking out at the sea, wind in the grass
shots.video_prompt: clouds drift, waves roll in far below, leaves and grass sway in the wind, the boy's scarf flutters

shots.description: The mirror shows someone else's room instead of Fann.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of a small round brass hand mirror on the counter tilted toward the viewer, instead of a reflection it shows a warm lamp-lit child's bedroom far away
shots.video_prompt: a faint shimmer ripples across the mirror's surface

shots.description: Where his dreams went: a sleepless girl, finally smiling.
shots.image_prompt: Medium-wide, the girl asleep in her bed hugging the orange stuffed fox, smiling softly in her sleep, tiny golden motes of light drifting up from her pillow like little dreams
shots.video_prompt: golden motes rise and drift slowly, string lights twinkle, her breathing is slow and calm

shots.description: The choice: he walks home with the jar, not the money.
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot from behind, Fann walking alone down an empty rain-wet street holding the glowing jar against his chest, its warm light spilling onto the wet pavement, lit windows high above
shots.video_prompt: light rain, reflections shimmer on the pavement, the jar's glow sways with his steps

shots.description: Back in the dream: the adult walks toward the tree he almost sold.
shots.image_prompt: Very wide shot, Fann tiny against the landscape, walking up the grassy cliff toward the enormous old tree in bright sunlight
shots.video_prompt: grass ripples in the wind, cloud shadows slide across the cliff

shots.description: The final image: a letter left for him beneath the old tree.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of the old tree's mossy roots in dappled sunlight, a folded cream-coloured letter tucked between them, held down by a small pressed wildflower
shots.video_prompt: dappled light shifts across the letter as leaves move above

sound.music_palette: Felt piano with a sparse two-note motif, about 64 BPM, very soft; distant low strings for the cost; celesta and glass tones for the reveal. Never louder than the voice.

cues.note: Single felt-piano motif under the rain bed
Piano drops to single notes in Fann's room
Low strings rise gently with the oldest jar's glow (restrained)
All music out during the pause after 'pays for everything'; rain and room tone only
Celesta and glass tones join the piano as the mirror shows the girl
Motif resolves in a warmer register; strings fall away
Music fades; the brass moon bell chimes alone over the final frame

ambience: shop room tone with a faint clock
wind and sea in the dream
